title: Upgrade player vehicle to a small race car (better-looking)

requirements.text: Update the in-game player vehicle visuals to look like a small, best-looking race car (sport/racing style) instead of a basic/local-looking car, without changing any gameplay logic (controls, speed, scoring, collisions, obstacle behavior).

quotes: Mujhe pahle wali gadi wali Meri game banaa rahe the usko kuchh behtar banaa do aapane uske andar local gadi Dali Hui aap uske andar race wali gadi dalo small jo sabse acchi Lage

acceptanceCriteria: In gameplay, the only vehicle (player car) has a clearly recognizable race-car style silhouette (e.g., low profile body, sportier proportions, racing details such as a simple spoiler/wing or aerodynamic shapes).
The player car is visually smaller than before (reduced overall scale) while remaining clearly visible on mobile.
Gameplay behavior is unchanged: steering, speed progression, scoring, and collision detection outcomes remain the same as before this change.
No additional vehicles are introduced; only the player car is present as a vehicle.

requirements.text: Replace the player car’s current texture usage with a new racing-style texture asset and apply it to the player car materials so the car looks like a race car (e.g., bold color blocks/stripes/number panel), keeping assets original and stored under frontend/public/assets/generated.

quotes: race wali gadi dalo small jo sabse acchi Lage

acceptanceCriteria: The player car no longer uses /assets/generated/traffic-jam-player-car-texture.dim_1024x512.png as its primary body texture.
A new racing-style texture from frontend/public/assets/generated is used on the player car body material(s).
The new texture appears correctly oriented (not mirrored unintentionally) and looks sharp (no obvious stretching) on the car body.

constraints: Frontend user-facing text (if any is added/changed as part of this work) must be in English.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not change gameplay rules or physics/collision logic; this change is visual-only.
nonGoals: Adding new game modes (laps, timers, opponents) or changing difficulty.

required: Racing car texture with bold stripes and a simple number panel (race-car-texture.dim_1024x512.png)
